title: Suncrete Announces Q3 2026 Earnings Results
summary: Revenue Up 163% Compared to Q3 2025 and Up 45% Compared to Q2 2026 TULSA, Okla., Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --…...
body_markdown:
*Revenue Up 163% Compared to Q3 2025 and Up 45% Compared to Q2 2026*


TULSA, Okla.


, Nov. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Suncrete, Inc. (NASDAQ: RMIX) (the "Company"), a ready-mix concrete logistics and distribution platform strategically located in the Sunbelt region of the United States, today announced results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


Randall Edgar, Suncrete's Chief Executive Officer, stated, "We are pleased with our performance in the third quarter, with revenue and Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA increasing 163% and 62%, respectively, compared to the second quarter which led to a 150 basis point improvement in Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA margin. Our acquisition integration plans are progressing, with several businesses moving toward Suncrete's target margin levels. We also took a significant step forward in North Texas, as we further advanced through our integration playbook to improve results."


Revenues were $141.0 million in the third quarter, an increase of 45% compared to $97.2 million in the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of 163% compared to $53.5 million in the same quarter last year.


Net income was $78 thousand in the third quarter, compared to net loss of $37.1 million in the second quarter of 2026 and net income of $4.6 million in the same quarter last year. Adjusted EBITDA(1) in the third quarter was $22.4 million, an increase of 66% compared to $13.5 million in the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of 64% compared to $13.7 million in the same quarter last year.


Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA(1), which excludes affiliated consultant compensation, in the third quarter was $23.3 million, an increase of 60% compared to $14.6 million in the second quarter of 2026.


Total yards of ready-mix concrete produced and delivered in the third quarter increased 32% compared to the second quarter of 2026 and increased 125% compared to the same quarter last year.


(1) Adjusted EBITDA, Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA and Supplemental EBITDA margin are financial measures not presented in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP"). Please see "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" at the end of this press release for additional information.


**2026 Outlook**


Edgar added, "Our Sunbelt markets remained active, supporting approximately 10% organic revenue growth and margin expansion in the third quarter. As we approach year-end, some large projects are shifting start dates into 2027, while elevated interest rates continue to pressure residential construction. Our revised outlook ranges reflect these conditions.


"Heading into 2027, we expect significant organic and acquisitive growth as we continue to scale our ready-mix platform across the Sunbelt. Our acquisition pipeline is strong and expanding, and we expect to enter the new year with a healthy pipeline of large commercial projects and robust infrastructure activity across our states."


This guidance is based on current economic conditions and assumes no signiﬁcant changes in the overall economy or other condition in the Sunbelt region of the United States in 2026. The guidance does not include the potential contribution of any future acquisitions.


- Revenue in the range of $408.0 million to $434.0 million
- Net loss in the range of $(48.7) million to $(44.7) million
- Adjusted net income (loss) in the range of $(21.8) million to $(17.8) million(2)
- Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $60.0 million to $64.0 million(2)
- Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $63.6 million to $67.6 million(2)


(2) Adjusted net income, Adjusted EBITDA and Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA are financial measures not presented in accordance with GAAP. Please see "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" at the end of this press release for additional information.


Ned N. Fleming, III, the Company's Executive Chairman, stated, "Our team continues to build Suncrete's scale and strengthen our local market positions through organic growth and disciplined acquisitions. We acquire high-quality local businesses, retain the leadership and customer relationships that distinguish them, and provide the capital, technology, and operating support to accelerate their growth. As we expand our network, greater market density, purchasing power, and fleet productivity create opportunities to improve margins and returns on invested capital. Our experienced leadership team and repeatable operating model provide a foundation to enter new attractive Sunbelt markets, increase local share, and compound shareholder value over time."


**Conference Call**


The Company will conduct a conference call today at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time (9:00 a.m. Central Time) to discuss financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. To access the call live by phone, dial (412) 902-0003 and ask for the Suncrete call at least 10 minutes prior to the start time. A webcast of the call will also be available live and for later replay on the Company's Investor Relations website at[www.suncrete.com.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821917-1&h=2563440988&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.suncrete.com%2F&a=%C2%A0www.suncrete.com.)


**About Suncrete**


Suncrete is a leading pure-play ready-mix concrete company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, serving a diversified customer base across infrastructure, commercial, and residential construction projects throughout Oklahoma, Arkansas, Texas, and Louisiana, and concrete products in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Missouri. Suncrete is a scalable and vertically integrated logistics and distribution platform operating as a mission-critical partner in the construction value chain. The Company operates batching plants, a dedicated fleet of owned mixer trucks and a tech-enabled dispatch infrastructure through its decentralized


plant network supported by regionally centralized leadership in local markets. Suncrete optimizes purchasing, pricing, customer relationships, and fleet utilization, enabling consistent customer service and reliable delivery of products on time and to customers' specifications. With a disciplined acquisition strategy and a focus on some of the nation's fastest-growing and most resilient construction markets, Suncrete is well positioned to benefit from continued population growth, urbanization, and infrastructure investment across the U.S. Sunbelt. To learn more, visit[www.suncrete.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821917-1&h=1755925564&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.suncrete.com%2F&a=www.suncrete.com) .

***Non-GAAP Financial Measures***


Adjusted EBITDA represents net income (loss) before interest expense, net, depreciation and amortization, and further adjusted to exclude certain non-cash or non-operating items that management does not consider indicative of our core operating performance. Such adjustments include share-based compensation expense, acquisition-related fair value inventory step-up, acquisition-related costs, acquisition bonuses, public company readiness costs, and other (income) expense, as each are applicable to the periods presented. Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA further adjusts Adjusted EBITDA to exclude recurring affiliated consultant compensation. Management believes these measures provide investors with a clearer view of underlying operating performance. Adjusted EBITDA margin and Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA margin represent these measures as a percentage of revenue.


Management uses these measures as key performance indicators to evaluate our operating performance and assess trends, and believes they are also frequently used by securities analysts, investors, and other parties to evaluate companies in our industry. Management believes these non-GAAP measures enhance investors' understanding of our operating performance and facilitate meaningful period-to-period comparisons. These measures have limitations as analytical tools and should not be considered as an alternative to net income or any other performance measure derived in accordance with GAAP as an indicator of our operating performance. Our calculation of Adjusted EBITDA, Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA margin, and Supplemental Adjusted EBITDA margin may not be comparable to similarly named measures reported by other companies. Potential differences may include differences in capital structures, tax positions and the age and book depreciation of intangible and tangible assets
